title: Probing Visual Planning in Image Editing Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.22868v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual planning represents a crucial facet of human intelligence, especially in tasks that require complex spatial reasoning and navigation. Yet, in machine learning, this inherently visual problem is often tackled through a verbal-centric lens. While recent research demonstrates the promise of fully visual approaches, they suffer from significant computational inefficiency due to the step-by-step planning-by-generation paradigm. In this work, we present EAR, an editing-as-reasoning paradigm that reformulates visual planning as a single-step image transformation. To isolate intrinsic reasoning from visual recognition, we employ abstract puzzles as probing tasks and introduce AMAZE, a procedurally generated dataset that features the classical Maze and Queen problems, covering distinct, complementary forms of visual planning. translated_title: 探究图像编辑模型中的视觉规划能力
translated_abstract: 视觉规划是人类智能的一个重要方面，尤其是在需要复杂空间推理和导航的任务中。然而在机器学习领域，这一本质上属于视觉的问题往往通过以语言为中心的视角来解决。虽然近期研究表明完全视觉方法具有潜力，但由于逐步式的“通过生成进行规划”范式，这些方法存在显著的计算效率低下问题。在本工作中，我们提出了 EAR（编辑即推理，editing-as-reasoning）范式，将视觉规划重新表述为单步图像变换。为了将内在推理能力与视觉识别分离开来，我们采用抽象谜题作为探测任务，并引入 AMAZE——一个程序化生成的数据集，包含经典的迷宫和皇后问题，涵盖不同且互补的视觉规划形式。AMAZE 的抽象特性也便于对自回归模型和扩散模型进行自动评估。
tldr: 本文提出 EAR（编辑即推理）范式，将视觉规划重新表述为单步图像变换以大幅提升计算效率，并引入程序化生成的抽象谜题数据集 AMAZE（包含迷宫和皇后问题），用于系统探测图像编辑模型中自回归与扩散模型的视觉规划能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EAR, an editing-as-reasoning paradigm that reformulates visual planning as a single-step image transformation, and introduces AMAZE, a procedurally generated abstract puzzle dataset featuring Maze and Queen problems, to probe the visual planning capabilities of autoregressive and diffusion-based image editing models with significantly improved computational efficiency.
